description: Add an induction loop (E1) detector to the Bologna Acosta road network using netedit. The netedit application is already open with the Bologna Acosta network loaded. This is a real-world road network from the Acosta area in Bologna, Italy. Your task is to: 1. Switch to Additional mode by pressing 'A' or clicking the blue diamond icon in the mode toolbar. 2. In the left panel, select 'Induction Loop (E1)' from the additional element dropdown. 3. Set the detector ID to 'new_detector_1' in the attributes panel. 4. Set the frequency (freq) attribute to '300' (data collection interval in seconds). 5. Set the output file attribute to 'new_detector_output.xml'. 6. Click on any lane in the network to place the detector. 7. Save the additional file by pressing Ctrl+Shift+A (Save Additionals) or use File > Save Additionals.
